messages.content: 你可以幫我規劃我的假期嗎？我需要知道總花費。首先，我正在考慮在紐約希爾頓酒店住5晚豪華客房。你能告訴我那會花多少錢嗎？其次，我正在考慮從Enterprise租一輛轎車10天。那會是多少錢？最後，我計劃搭乘Delta Airlines的商務艙，我們會有3個人。你能告訴我總的機票費用嗎？

function.name: flight_ticket_pricing_get
function.description: Get pricing for a specific type of flight ticket for specified number of passengers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: car_rental_pricing_get
function.description: Get pricing for a specific type of rental car for a specified number of days. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

rentalCompany.description: The name of the rental company.

carType.description: Type of the car to be rented.

days.description: Number of days to rent the car.

function.name: hotel_room_pricing_get
function.description: Get pricing for a specific type of hotel room for specified number of nights. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hotelName.description: The name of the hotel e.g. Hilton New York

roomType.description: Type of the room to be booked.

nights.description: Number of nights to book the room for.
